## Detailed Service Offerings

### 1. Modular Kitchen Design & Manufacturing
- Factory-finished precision modular kitchen cabinets with soft-close tandem boxes and hinges.
- Waterproof BWP/BWR grade marine plywood, HDMR (High-Density Moisture-Resistant) boards, acrylic sheets, lacquered glass, laminate, and PVC options.
- Layout options: L-Shaped Kitchens, U-Shaped Kitchens, Parallel Galley Kitchens, Island Kitchens, Straight Wall Kitchens.
- Custom accessories: Pull-out pantries, corner carousel units, cutlery trays, chimney & hob integrated units.

### 2. Residential Interior Design
- Complete 2BHK, 3BHK, Independent Villa, and Apartment turnkey interior designs.
- Living Room Designs: TV units with louvers and profile LED lighting, wall paneling, false ceiling designs.
- Master & Kids Bedroom Designs: Modular sliding wardrobes, walk-in closets, study tables, headboard paneling.
- Dining & Foyer Area: Partition screens, crockery units, shoe racks, decorative ceiling light fixtures.

### 3. Commercial & Retail Interior Design
- Turnkey commercial fit-outs for Salons, Spas, Cafes, Restaurants, Boutiques, Jewellery Shops, Retail Stores, and Medical Clinics.
- Corporate Office Design: Reception counters, executive desks, conference rooms, acoustic ceiling tiles, glass wall partitions, aluminium frame partitions.

### 4. Exterior Architecture & ACP Elevation
- Front elevation designs for modern homes and commercial buildings.
- Aluminum Composite Panel (ACP) cladding, HPL (High-Pressure Laminate) elevation sheets, exterior louvers, glass facade installation.

### 5. Shipping Container Architecture
- Container Homes, Container Cafes, and Modular Portable Offices designed and fabricated in Tamil Nadu.
